purpose: Record manually reviewed 2D provenance for real user-supplied flight photos without promoting them to 3D ground truth.
global_claim: These annotations support detector/input provenance and replay reproducibility. They cannot support an image-to-3D SOTA ranking or a ground-truth first row for 3D quality metrics.

items.label: tower
items.review_reason: User-supplied real flight photo of an electrical lattice pylon; YOLOE-26s detects 'electric pylon' (conf 0.49) with a 75-point native mask.

items.label: tractor
items.review_reason: User-supplied real flight photo of a tractor on a field road; YOLOE-26s mislabels it 'two-wheeled vehicle' (conf 0.48), exercising the conservative family-routing path.
